title: Source-post deletion verification retries silently until it gives up
current: When verifying a deletion finds the post still live or the lookup inconclusive, reschedule() saves a new attempt with no log line. Only the final exhausted attempt logs source_post_deletion_attempts_exhausted, and the intent then becomes terminal_failed.
evidence: reschedule() calls saveSourcePostDeletionIntent and logs only when retry.exhausted. Its callers pass reasons such as 'source_still_live' and 'source_lookup_inconclusive' that never reach the logs. Combined with R-W6-01 (a post the app deleted still reads as active), verification can retry silently for the whole retry budget and end terminal_failed, leaving the goal registered.
required: An info line per reschedule with the reason and attempt count (or the cron run summary), and a warn line when the intent becomes terminal_failed that names the post and the last reason.
tests: A verification that sees removedByCategory undefined logs each reschedule with reason source_still_live and attemptCount.

criticality.why: A stuck deletion leaves a deleted goal registered with no trace until the retry budget runs out.
